text: This code iterates through the list `xs` from the first element to the second-to-last element, checking if each element matches the `target`. If a match is found, it immediately returns the index of that match. If no match is found after checking all elements, it returns -1. However, it does not check the last element of the list, which means it will not find the target if it is at the end of the list. This behavior differs from the task description, which asks for the index of the FIRST occurrence of the target, implying that the target could be at the end of the list.
